title: prompts/33d R4: qiskit-aer release notes 0.16.x and 0.17.x read for a cuStateVec Kraus / non-unitary noise fix
read: 2026-10-13 (UTC-6 afternoon), by the executor on branch c33c

sources.what: the reno release notes page (Aer documentation), searched for 'kraus' and 'custatevec'
issue / PR search: 0 results; 'custatevec noise': 3 results (#2423 cuda arch thrust compat, #2213 GPU build without a GPU, #2194 qiskit-aer-gpu install problem), none about Kraus or noise sampling

versions.0.16 (2025-01-09): support for Qiskit 1.3; PRs: open_pulse entry, test fixes, Revert NoiseModel.from_dict, save_expval truncation, MPS size estimator, conditional with empty body, MPS save, controlled-gate compilation; nothing on cuStateVec, Kraus or noise sampling
versions.0.16.3 (2025-03-04): removal of deprecated Qiskit-2.0 code, Rust temporarily removed from the build
versions.0.17 (2025-03-13): compatibility release with Qiskit 2.0: noise-model update for Qiskit 1.4.x / 2.x (PR 2329), BaseEstimator import
versions.0.17.2 (2025-09-17): GPU builds and tests for Qiskit >= 2.1 (PR 2368), typo and Windows build fixes

cuStateVec_or_Kraus_mentions_in_the_note: 0.15.0: 'The option cuStateVec_enable=True was not set correctly. This fix set this option to statevector, unitary and density_matrix simulator states classes before allocating their memory' (PR 2146) -- already contained in 0.15.1, the version the CI runs
0.15.0: 'Fix noise sampling on shot-branching' (PR 2098) -- shot branching is off in every campaign-33 simulator
0.12.0 / 0.11.0: Kraus support in AerState / AerStatevector, cuStateVec introduction and API fixes (older than 0.15)
finding: No release note of 0.16.x or 0.17.x names a fix to Kraus channels, non-unitary noise sampling or the cuStateVec execution path; 0.16-0.17.2 are compatibility and build releases. A newer qiskit-aer-gpu is therefore not expected to change the C2_CAL GPU Kraus result, and nothing upstream documents the defect: if C2_KCHK confirms it (K1), it is a new report for Qiskit/qiskit-aer (prompts/33d R4).
